data.name: Jaibir
data.gender_notes: Jaibir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ja-i (Conqueror) + Bir (Victorious, Warrior) = One who conquers and is victorious. The name Jaibir carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jaibir usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jaibir is a name that represents the inner warrior, one who conquers challenges and achieves victory in life. It is a name that inspires courage, strength, and the determination to overcome obstacles.
data.etymology: Jaibir belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaibir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The meaning of the name reflects the warrior culture and the desire for power and dominance that was prevalent during that time. It is also a name that conveys an aura of strength and determination, making it an inspiring choice for individuals today.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jaibir can symbolize the inner victory over one's weaknesses and challenges.
